About the Role

In this role, you will be an integral player within Data Science team based on Jakarta. You will take the wheel in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models for a variety of consumer and merchant lending products GoPay offers in Indonesia. Your responsibilities will include enhancing our credit risk models by leveraging innovative and cutting-edge algorithms on GoTo data and third-party data vendors. Most importantly, your efforts will work to bring wider financial inclusion to more people in the region and beyond.

What You Will Do

• Drive End-to-End Impact: Take complete ownership of the machine learning lifecycle. You will conceptualize, build, deploy, and monitor data models that directly influence key business metrics and bottom-line results.
• Innovate Credit Risk Strategy: Lead the development of advanced consumer credit risk models. Apply rigorous statistical analysis and ML techniques to optimize lending decisions, balance risk, and fuel sustainable business growth.
• Partner with Product & Business: Act as a strategic bridge between data and business strategy. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable, production-ready data science solutions.
• Champion Technical Excellence: Set the standard for robust model evaluation and clear documentation. You will advocate for data science best practices and distill complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical leadership.

What You Will Need

• Bachelor degree or above in science and engineering related majors such as statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, etc.
• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models.
• Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
• Comfortable using Python, SQL, and UNIX Shell.
• Understand business concerns and formulate them as technical problems that can be solved using data and math/stats/ML.
• Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a strong sense of ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
• Good communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
• Able to write model documentation clearly and concisely and support recommendations with research and data.

About the Team

Our team leverages big data from the GoTo universe, as well as external data, to build various predictive models to support the risk strategy team in real-time credit underwriting and management of the customer lifecycle Cicil (BNPL) and Pinjam (cash loans) products. As our model scores are key inputs to risk decisioning (e.g. approval/rejection of loans, credit limit adjustments), we are also able to see the direct impact of our models on the business and our customers.

We are a growing team and are constantly looking for opportunities to use data science to enhance our credit and fraud risk management capabilities. We are focused on growth and efficiency. We are all about open knowledge sharing and self-improvement. We believe that “Data Science is a team sport.”

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavour powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.

Job Title – Foods ID Customer Experience & Logistics Lead

Function – Supply Chain

Reports to Head of Supply Chain – Foods Indonesia

JOB PURPOSE

Lead the end-to-end Customer Experience & Logistics strategy, targeting operating model and performance framework for Foods Indonesia, delivering world-class customer service and logistics performance while shaping the function's strategy, operating model and transformation roadmap. The role integrates customer, operational and commercial priorities to drive service excellence, cost competitiveness, resilience and sustainable growth, serving as the key supply chain partner to Customer Development and the voice of the customer in business decision-making.

You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Set and execute the Indonesia Foods Customer Service & Logistics strategy, target operating model, performance framework and multi-year improvement roadmap.
• Lead and develop the Customer Experience & Logistics organisation, building strong capabilities, clear accountability, effective governance and a high-performing team culture.
• Own Indonesia customer-service performance, including service level, OTIF, order fulfilment, issue resolution, customer satisfaction, cost-to-serve and process efficiency.
• Own end-to-end performance across customer service, warehousing, transport and distribution, delivering service excellence, operational efficiency, resilience, compliance and sustainable value creation.
• Drive S&OP for business to delivering Service, Cash (Inventory), and Cost (Business Waste reduction), through close collaboration with cross-functional team.
• Act as the senior Supply Chain business partner to the Foods Indonesia Customer Development lead and leadership team, jointly shaping customer collaboration priorities and the supply-chain contribution to commercial growth plans.
• Lead the continuous improvement and digital transformation portfolio across customer service and logistics, including process simplification, network optimisation, automation and technology-enabled capabilities
• Build a fact-based cost-to-serve agenda across Europe and convert insights into country and regional efficiency plans with clear ownership, investment requirements and benefit tracking.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• ​​Senior leadership experience in Customer Service, Customer Operations, Logistics or end -to-end supply chain within FMCG or another complex customer environment.
• Strong practical understanding of order fulfilment, customer service, planning and logistics interfaces, warehousing, transport, distribution networks and third-party logistics management.
• Proven success leading operational and transformation teams and building consistent performance in a matrix organisation.
• Demonstrated success partnering senior commercial leaders and customers to improve service, strengthen collaboration and support growth.
• Proven track record of setting strategy and delivering large-scale service, cost, productivity, resilience, sustainability or operating-model improvement.
• Strong commercial and financial acumen, including customer profitability, cost-to-serve, service differentiation, business cases, investment choices and benefit delivery.
• Strong programme leadership, change management, stakeholder management, communication and conflict-resolution skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• ​​Track record leading transformation, operating-model change, process improvement, digitalisation or automation across SEA markets.
• Executive-level influencing, communication and conflict-resolution skills

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
